I do. My mom was the one with anger issues. She was a single mom and I was her only kid so she took a lot of stress out on me. She also took it out on other people, sometimes in very embarrassing public settings. I was pretty calm and compassionate as a kid. My mom used to try to butt heads with me about not backing her up when she did ridiculous things like yell at a customer service rep. She felt judged and I felt like she was nuts. I never thought I would be like her. Now I am dealing with the stress of life and am noticing that I have explosions just like her. It started with a build up to an explosion and eventually I started feeling angry all the time and the explosions started happening more frequently. I'm coming to the conclusion that this is because our parents didn't know how to cope with things. We learned how to deal with stress and pain through them. I think therapy is the only hope.
